verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports configuration-as-code via its Terraform provider, enabling version control of connection/source/destination configs in git, and the Connection Timeline gives a historical audit view of sync events for review. However, there is no documented rollback mechanism for reverting a connection/automation to a prior version, nor any built-in review/approval workflow beyond external Terraform practices. Missing for 10: native rollback/undo of pipeline configs, in-app review/approval flow, and versioned history of connection definitions beyond Terraform state.
